newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Limako wins EU 400-tonne Angola sugar tender.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Limako wins EU 400-tonne Angola sugar tender.

text.p: Dutch sugar firm Limako Suiker BV said on Thursday it had been awarded a tender by the European Commission to supply 400 tonnes of white sugar as food aid to Angola.
Limako said the sugar, priced at 329.50 Ecus per tonne free at port of Amsterdam, would be shipped by arrangement with the beneficiaries, the Rome-based World Food Programme.
A European Commission source confirmed the award.
The tender was announced by the Commission in the Official Journal on May 6.
